page.notes: Printed page 64 with running head "De Materia Et Mixto". The last line "igitur" is the catchword at the lower right. The text is set in roman with many italic passages. Marginal notes are faint and not legible enough to transcribe with confidence; none are recorded above. Some words in the last line and the foot line may be doubtful, and the scan is slightly blurred at the left edge. A few words such as "spiritis" and "Alioquin en tibi" may be misread and should be checked against the original.
